profile_text.body:
Asana is a publicly traded work and project management software company (ticker: ASAN, CIK: 0001477720) whose platform is designed for teams that include both human workers and AI agents. The company describes its software as enabling teams to plan, automate, and execute critical workflows, and it positions its product around a concept it calls the Work Graph, which supplies AI agents with shared memory, governance, and organizational context.

Asana's primary AI product, tracked here as Asana AI, covers work management, goal tracking, team productivity analytics, and data residency options. The company describes a suite it calls Agentic Work Management, which brings together AI Teammates, AI Studio, Asana Dash, and MCP and AI Connectors. It offers pre-built AI agents intended to operate inside existing workflows from the outset, as well as tools for teams to build custom AI Teammates tailored to coordination-heavy tasks. The site quotes Simone Williams, Chief Digital, Technology and Business Development Officer at COS, describing gains in visibility and speed through scalable workflows and intentional AI use.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings beyond the basic public-company profile are recorded in the held facts for Asana at this time.
